welcome.title: Welcome to NexusFi!
welcome.body: Get to know each module with practical examples and voice narration. It takes a few minutes and you can pause any time.
welcome.hint: You can open the guide at any time with the help button.

completion.title: Tour complete!
completion.body: You now know what each area is for. If you have questions about a module, the help button is always nearby.

dashboard.title: Understand your dashboard
dashboard.description: The dashboard gathers your key business indicators in one place: period result, comparison with the previous period, cash projection for the coming days, due dates and alerts.
dashboard.purpose: It helps you quickly see how the company is doing and what needs attention, without opening each module. Use the month selector in the top bar to change the period.
dashboard.example: On opening the panel you see bills due this week and a tight projected balance in 15 days, so you decide to collect a payment early.
dashboard.benefit: You see the overall situation in seconds and act before problems happen.

fluxoCaixa.title: Understand your cash flow
fluxoCaixa.description: Cash flow shows the money coming in and going out of the company over time, with balance and transactions organized by category.
fluxoCaixa.purpose: It helps you track available funds and plan payments. It is not revenue or profit: it shows the money that actually came in and went out.
fluxoCaixa.example: Your company receives R$ 5,000 from customers and pays R$ 2,000 in expenses in the period. Considering only these movements, the difference is a net inflow of R$ 3,000.
fluxoCaixa.benefit: You see how each movement affects cash and plan your commitments better.

contasPagar.title: How accounts payable work
contasPagar.description: Here you record the company's financial commitments with due dates and track what is pending and what has been paid. The module also covers purchase orders and suppliers.
contasPagar.purpose: It organizes obligations to avoid delays, fines and interest. When a cash flow outflow matches a bill, it can be settled automatically.
contasPagar.example: Rent of R$ 3,000 is due on the 10th. You add the bill, see the due alert, and when you record the payment in cash flow the bill is settled.
contasPagar.benefit: Fewer late payments and fines, and a clear view of what must be paid.

contasReceber.title: How accounts receivable work
contasReceber.description: It tracks the money your customers still have to pay: amounts, due dates, what has been received and what is open or overdue.
contasReceber.purpose: It helps you track delinquency and organize collections. On Pro you can send email charges with Pix copy-and-paste and automatic reminders.
contasReceber.example: A customer owes R$ 1,800 due tomorrow. You send the charge and, when the money arrives, the receipt is recorded and the bill is settled.
contasReceber.benefit: You know who owes what and since when, and get paid faster.

faturamento.title: Understand revenue
faturamento.description: Revenue is the total sold in a period, whether or not the customer has paid. You can find it in the Revenue report, under Reports.
faturamento.purpose: It shows the size of your sales. It differs from receipts (money that came in), profit (what is left after costs) and cash balance (money available now).
faturamento.example: You sold R$ 10,000 this month but have only received R$ 6,000. Revenue is R$ 10,000; cash received is R$ 6,000; profit still depends on costs.
faturamento.benefit: It avoids confusing a sale with money in the bank and helps measure growth.

vendas.title: How the sales panel works
vendas.description: The sales panel gathers sales from connected channels and manual sales, with performance indicators. On Pro there is also the POS, with opening and closing of the cash register per shift.
vendas.purpose: It helps you track commercial performance and link each sale to stock and cash. Completed, cancelled and received sales are different situations.
vendas.example: A R$ 200 counter sale is recorded in the POS; the product stock decreases and the amount goes into the shift's cash.
vendas.benefit: You understand what you sell, through which channel and with what result.

estoque.title: How inventory works
estoque.description: Register products and track available quantities, with inflows and outflows.
estoque.purpose: It prevents stockouts and excess idle goods. Inventory value, sales revenue and cost of goods sold are different things.
estoque.example: You have 20 T-shirts and sell 5: stock drops to 15. When it gets close to the minimum, it's time to restock.
estoque.benefit: You restock at the right time and know how much money is tied up in goods.

integracoes.title: Marketplace integrations
integracoes.description: An integration connects NexusFi to a marketplace, such as Mercado Livre, TikTok Shop or Shein, to bring in products and orders automatically. You authorize the connection in the Inventory tab.
integracoes.purpose: It keeps data in sync without typing everything twice. The connection status appears on each integration's own screen; check it there to see whether it is connected.
integracoes.example: You authorize the connection with the marketplace; orders start appearing in the sales panel and stock is updated.
integracoes.benefit: Less manual work and fewer errors between what you sell and what you have in stock.

relatorios.title: How to use reports
relatorios.description: Reports turn your entries into analysis: Cash Flow, Revenue, Expenses, Income Statement and Sales. The Sales report shows cost, profit, margin and return on cost, and should not be confused with revenue or cash flow.
relatorios.purpose: They help you analyze results and decide. The income statement shows whether the company made a profit or a loss; Expenses shows where the money is going.
relatorios.example: In the Expenses report you see that freight costs grew, so you renegotiate with the carrier.
relatorios.benefit: Decisions based on numbers, not guesses.

impostos.title: How taxes work
impostos.description: Record and track the company's taxes and their due dates. On Pro, the invoice reader uses artificial intelligence to identify withholdings and create the entries.
impostos.purpose: It keeps tax obligations visible so you don't miss deadlines. Always confirm amounts with your accountant.
impostos.example: You add this month's tax due on the 20th and get a reminder before the date.
impostos.benefit: Lower risk of fines for forgetting and more predictable cash.

centroCustos.title: How cost centers work
centroCustos.description: Cost centers organize expenses by area, project or purpose in the company.
centroCustos.purpose: They show where money is being spent and how much each area consumes.
centroCustos.example: You separate Marketing and Operations expenses and find out which area is above expectations.
centroCustos.benefit: More control over spending and better cut or investment decisions.

equipe.title: Team and permissions
equipe.description: Invite people to work in the same account and choose which categories each can access. Sensitive actions can be protected by a PIN.
equipe.purpose: It lets you share work without giving full access. Each person sees only what was granted to them.
equipe.example: You grant only Accounts payable to the finance person, and they don't see the rest.
equipe.benefit: More security and more autonomy for the team.

configuracoes.title: Account settings
configuracoes.description: In Settings you adjust your profile and company data, appearance, WhatsApp alerts, and send suggestions or problem reports. Your subscription and trial are also managed in your account.
configuracoes.purpose: It sets the platform up your way with the right data, which appears, for example, in the charges sent to customers.
configuracoes.example: You fill in the company data so email charges go out with your name and document.
configuracoes.benefit: An organized account and more professional communication.
